## Summary

I analyzed the six requirements against the current state of the repo and found that most were already satisfied — the real gap was a **file-descriptor leak**.

### What was already in place (no change needed)
- **`HiCacheStorageConfig`** already declares `pp_rank`, `pp_size`, `attn_cp_rank`, `attn_cp_size`, `enable_storage_metrics`, and `extra_config` (requirements 4 & 5).
- **`HiCacheNixl.__init__`** already has no `plugin` parameter and sources plugin selection entirely from `storage_config.extra_config` via `NixlBackendConfig` — which already parses the nested `{"plugin": {"<name>": {"active": True}}}` form (requirement 3).
- **`register_files`** already accepts a `List[str]` and returns the registration handle (non-None on success) (requirement 6).

### The fix (requirements 1 & 2)
In `_execute_transfer` (`python/sglang/srt/mem_cache/storage/nixl/hicache_nixl.py`), the FILE path calls `file_manager.files_to_nixl_tuples(keys)`, which does `os.open` on one fd per file (stored at tuple index 2). Those fds were **never closed**, so every `get`/`batch_set`/`batch_get` leaked one fd per key.

I wrapped the transfer body in a `try` and added a `finally` block that closes every opened fd via `file_manager.close_file`, so cleanup happens on the success path, on every early `return False`, and when the transfer raises.

### Verification
Since the full `sglang` package pulls in heavy/mismatched deps in this sandbox, I isolated the two real nixl source modules (stubbing only `memory_pool_host`/`environ`) and drove them against the provided `nixl` stub agent:
- Init with no `plugin` param + `extra_config={'plugin': {'posix': {'active': True}}}` → selects POSIX/FILE ✓
- `register_files([str, str, str])` → returns non-None ✓
- `batch_set`, `batch_get`, `get` — fd count identical before/after (7→7), data round-trips correctly, in both tensor and addr/len modes ✓
- Error path (transfer raises) → returns `False` and fds still 7→7, confirming the `finally` cleanup ✓
